title: Choose the new visual world
question: The frosted-glass plate is being replaced, not polished. The roll assigned Ambient Field. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Ambient Field
options.lineage: tvOS and macOS ambient idle screens
options.thesis: No plate, no card: the whole window is a slow color field the iPhone's picture will replace, with the receiver name set huge on it.
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge blue field, no card. Status top-left, receiver name huge and left-aligned, the route under it, four flat toggles along the bottom. A PIN turns the field amber.
options.risk: Painted timidly, it becomes a generic gradient wallpaper; the blooms must be big, saturated, and cheap to repaint.

raised.raise: The field carries state: blue waiting, amber pairing, green live, graphite failed. No status dot does that job alone.
Waiting drifts free; pairing locks the field still so the PIN holds all the attention.
Every toggle reads on or off without color: filled mark plus label, not hue alone.
Name, status, and route lock to one label grid with fixed ranks.
An on toggle floods the whole control, not a tiny switch knob.

options.label: Room Display
options.lineage: meeting-room share screens and wayfinding signs
options.thesis: The window is a room sign: one instruction, Screen Mirroring › AirScreen, set like wayfinding.
options.viewport: Charcoal field. Small name plate top-left, toggles as a quiet text row top-right. Giant two-line instruction bottom-left: Screen Mirroring / receiver name.
options.risk: Familiar: this is where meeting-room displays and most receiver apps already land.

options.label: Course Map
options.lineage: ISOM orienteering map and control descriptions
options.thesis: Connecting is a three-control course, Control Center, Screen Mirroring, the receiver name, drawn in course purple.
options.viewport: Contour-line field. Purple course: start triangle, circles 1-2-3 labeled Control Center, Screen Mirroring, receiver name. The description table holds the toggles.
options.case: Holds product clarity: the connection steps become an unmissable course. Loses identification: iPhone users do not think in maps.
options.risk: A light map ground glares in a dim room and reads as a hobby theme.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on a signal bench
options.thesis: Waiting is an untriggered trace rolling free; connecting locks it still.
options.viewport: Graticule field with a rolling trace. Name in instrument caps on the bezel. PIN as seven-segment digits.
options.case: Loses identification (a bench instrument, not an iPhone screen) and holds clarity no better.
options.kept: Waiting drifts free; pairing locks still.
options.risk: Near-black with glowing green reads as a hacker costume.

options.label: Mesophotic Dive
options.lineage: technical dive down a reef wall
options.thesis: Connection stages as depths: surface, thermocline, reef, wall.
options.viewport: Depth-stage blue field, one cyan band marking the active state, name on the depth axis.
options.case: Loses both: diving is not a screen, and depth stages obscure a two-step task.
options.risk: Pure metaphor in front of a utility.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Each setting tied to its default by an amber link line whose pattern, not color, shows state.
options.viewport: Numbered lanes: Name, Full Screen, On Top, PIN, each with a link rail.
options.case: Loses both: turns a waiting screen into a settings schedule.

options.label: Box Stack
options.thesis: The receiver as an end label: name, status, and route in a fixed label grid.
options.viewport: One big box end label: name as the colorway line, status as the size run.
options.case: Loses both: retail archive, not a display.
options.kept: One strict label grid with fixed ranks.
options.risk: Orange cardboard in a dim room.

options.label: Racing Livery
options.thesis: Selecting a control floods it with livery color.
options.viewport: Graphite track, name as hull numerals, toggles as decal stamps.
options.case: Loses both: speed livery fights a calm waiting screen.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A standard dark receiver app: name, status, and a list of toggle switches, at Windows 11 craft.
canonCard.viewport: Dark app surface: receiver name and status up top, a settings list of toggle rows below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any settings page by design.
